verdict.rationale: Formant provides an Agent SDK and Cloud SDK/API that let external programs authenticate, ingest telemetry, and send commands to control real robots (formant-docs-2, formant-docs-4, formant-docs-9, formant-gh-1), which supports end-to-end robot commanding via SDK. However, there is no evidence of scoped/limited-permission credentials or AI-agent-specific auth mechanisms, and the OpenAPI spec probe returned 404s, suggesting the API surface isn't fully documented for programmatic discovery. Missing for 10: explicit scoped-credential/auth-token documentation, AI-agent-specific integration examples, and a public OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec.
